evidence.quote: In October, the Committee will initiate the balance sheet normalization program described in the June 2017 Addendum to the Committee's Policy Normalization Principles and Plans.
The Committee expects that economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant gradual increases in the federal funds rate
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and the measure excluding food and energy prices have declined this year and are running below 2 percent.
the labor market has continued to strengthen and that economic activity has been rising moderately so far this year.
Near-term risks to the economic outlook appear roughly balanced, but the Committee is monitoring inflation developments closely.

parsed.rationale: The statement holds rates steady but launches balance sheet runoff and reiterates expected gradual rate increases. A solid labor market offsets below-target inflation, giving a moderately hawkish net signal.
